# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment (RED phase) in the TDD loop |
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the Kent Beck-style RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across iterations |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Executes one complete TDD cycle (RED→GREEN→REFACTOR) with retry and optional learning |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python, delegates code generation and execution |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for TypeScript via vitest in Podman |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Go TDD cycles |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Drives TDD cycles across multiple LanguagePods for the same feature |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase (test, implementation, refactor) using LLM |
| TypeScriptWorkerAgent | src/agents/typescript_worker_agent.py | Generates TypeScript code for each TDD phase |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer with hash-based security validation |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Production ContainerRunner backed by rootless Podman |
| TypeScriptRunner | src/agents/typescript_runner.py | PodmanRunner pre-configured for TypeScript harness image |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src/agents/autonomous_tdd_agent.py | Builds features incrementally with TDD, ensemble learning, and self-healing |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses .feature files into FeatureSpec objects |
| GherkinExtractionAgent | src/agents/gherkin_extraction_agent.py | Reverse-engineers Gherkin scenarios from existing code and tests |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Checks generated code for forbidden imports and builtins |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality before implementation |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Detects redundant tests before writing them |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src/agents/tdd_failure_recorder.py | Records and self-heals from TDD failures |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Core playbook operations: creation, updates, merging, retrieval, persistence |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant playbook bullets |
| BulletDeduplicator | src/playbook/deduplication.py | Semantic deduplication of bullets using embedding similarity |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router.py | Domain-aware routing for prompt-level distillation |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Unified logger for TDD and ML experiments with PostgreSQL/SQLite fallback |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes generator performance and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes insights into actionable playbook updates |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| EnsembleLearner | src/ensemble/learner.py | Orchestrates multiple models learning in parallel with voting |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) |
| AuditClient | src/audit/client.py | Write-only audit client for emitting events |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store.py | Append-only audit event store with hash-chain integrity |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Extracts agent performance metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for code generation activities |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Exec as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant PM as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflect as Reflector
    participant Curate as Curator

    User->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    loop max_iterations times
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
        Planner-->>Runner: PodSpec
        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle
        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        LLM-->>Worker: code
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        Pod->>Exec: pulse(files)
        Exec-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
        deactivate Pod
        alt RED failed (security/policy)
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult (abort)
        else RED passed
            loop max_green_attempts
                Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error)
                Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
                LLM-->>Worker: code
                Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                Pod->>Exec: pulse(files)
                Exec-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
                deactivate Pod
                opt GREEN passed
                    break
                end
            end
            alt GREEN failed
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult (fail)
            else GREEN passed
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Exec: pulse(files)
                Exec-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
                deactivate Pod
                Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
                opt learning enabled
                    Cycle->>Reflect: reflect(task, gen, env)
                    Reflect-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                    Cycle->>Curate: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                    Curate-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                    Cycle->>PM: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta)
                    PM-->>Cycle: added_bullets
                end
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult (success)
            end
        end
        deactivate Cycle
        Runner->>Runner: collect result
        alt planner says COMPLETE or max iterations
            break
        end
    end
    Runner-->>User: IterativeResult
```
